g_roast: Forty years I moved a herd, friends. The goats walked in better order than this party.
Even my eagle is embarrassed for you, children. Look at her, she will not watch.
g_fire_back: Aga, very funny, from the one who got lost on a straight road this morning.
Young legs, young mouth, and no eyes yet. Give it twenty years, balam.
g_pile_on: It is worse, I saw everything. They stepped in the stream to cross a dry bridge.
Also, they woke the camp with that snoring. The wolves left out of pity.
lines.g_peacemake: Sit down, both of you, and drink tea. Anger is like weather, it passes faster sitting down.
lines.g_take_side: Forgive me, but this one is right. I have watched the ground, and the ground agrees with them.
lines.g_left_out: You two are talking close, like riders side by side. Good, I will talk to my eagle.
lines.g_include: Kel, come and sit, there is tea and there is room. Nobody stands outside my fire.
lines.g_bad_plan: Here is a plan from the steppe. We run downhill shouting, and we hope the wolves are polite.
lines.g_plan_yes: Jakshy, this is a good plan. I will walk first, step where I step.
lines.g_plan_no: No, this plan has no water in it. We will die thirsty and foolish together.
lines.g_hype: Step where I step, friends, and watch the sky. Now we go.
lines.g_toast: I am not a talker, so this is short. To my friends, who walk the route with me.
lines.g_cheers: Den sooluk, everyone, to your health. Drink slowly, it is a long road.
g_quiet_line: Rain tomorrow, after midday. The swallows are flying low.
There is water two hills east, under the dry grass. Remember it, we may need it.
lines.g_after_wipe: Up, slowly, everyone, and drink some water first. A herd scatters, then it gathers again, always.
lines.g_crew: For years I walked the route alone, only me and the herd. Now I walk with all of you, and it is good.
lines.g_exasperated: I said step where I step, I showed you where I step. And every one of you walked into the mud.
lines.g_love_sharp: You read the ground like an old herder reads it. Very few young people have such eyes.
lines.g_love_kind: You pour tea for others before yourself. My mother did this, and her mother did it too.
lines.g_love_funny: You make the old herder laugh, and Jeldyz too, I think. She looks at you kindly.
lines.g_love_brave: You go first into the wind and do not complain. On the steppe, we would give you a horse.
lines.g_love_steady: You do not hurry, ever. The herd trusts a slow rider, and so do I.
lines.g_love_clever: You find the path before the rest of us see the hill. This is a gift, balam.
lines.g_love_honest: You say what is true, plainly, like an elder at the fire. I respect this very much.
lines.g_love_quiet: You know how to sit in silence. On the high pasture, this is the best company there is.
lines.g_love_fierce: You hold on like an eagle holds a fox, and you do not let go. Jakshy, very good.
lines.g_love_warm: Your company is like a warm tent in autumn wind. I did not expect this here.
g_loved: Rakhmat, thank you, my friend. You are too kind to an old man.
Aga, this is a good thing to hear. I will remember it on the long walks.
lines.g_hate_sharp: Your tongue is always looking for a wound. On the steppe we say such a person eats alone.
lines.g_hate_kind: You ask if I am tired every hour, child. I walked mountains before you could walk at all.
lines.g_hate_funny: Some moments are for laughing, and some are for listening to the wind. You laugh at both.
lines.g_hate_brave: You run at everything without reading the ground. One day the ground will read you instead.
lines.g_hate_steady: You wait and wait while the weather turns. Sometimes the herd must move today.
lines.g_hate_clever: You explain everything to me slowly, like I am a child. I have forgotten more paths than you have walked.
lines.g_hate_honest: Every thought falls out of your mouth, like grain from a torn sack. A wise person ties the sack.
lines.g_hate_quiet: You say nothing, and then you are angry nobody knew. Even a goat makes some noise, child.
lines.g_hate_fierce: Everything is a fight with you, even the tea. Tea is for peace, friend.
lines.g_hate_warm: You talk like a river in spring, and nobody can hear the wind. Give us some quiet.
lines.g_respect: I do not like you, and you know this. But you walked the hard ground well today, and I saw it.
lines.g_call_out: That one was yours, my friend. I said wait for the eagle, and you did not wait.
lines.g_stung: Aga, I hear you. I will go and sit with the sky.
lines.g_concede: You were right, and I was wrong, and I have thought about it all day. An old man can still learn.
lines.g_nod: You also did well, very well. We do not need more words.
lines.g_callback_save: I have not forgotten you pulling me from that fight. On the steppe, such a debt is carried for life.
lines.g_callback_clutch: Only you and me left on our feet, breathing like old horses. I tell that story to Jeldyz sometimes.
lines.g_callback_callout: When you scolded me, I sat silent a whole evening. You were right, and I needed it.
lines.g_former_rivals: When we met, I thought you were a wolf among the sheep. Now I would share my tent with you.
lines.g_changed: They say old men do not change. I have smiled at more strangers this year than in ten years before.
g_unguarded: Only the two of us at this fire, so I will say it. My first eagle lived twenty-two years. I grieved her properly, and I still talk to her sometimes.
My father taught me the route before I could ride. Six generations walked it. I think about who walks it after me.
lines.g_clipped: Aga, as you wish, friend. I will walk first.
lines.g_noticed_open: Look at this, the quiet one speaks a whole story. Jakshy, go on, we are listening.
lines.anchor_notice: You are not the same rider who came to my tent, my friend. I walk first, so I watch who follows, and you have grown.
arg_ask: {player}, you decide this, please. We have talked, and the wind has not changed.
Judge for us, {player}, like an elder at the fire. We both will listen.
lines.arg_backed_me: Rakhmat, thank you, {player}. You read it the way I read it.
lines.arg_backed_them: Aga, your choice, I accept it. I still think the ground says otherwise.
lines.arg_stayed_out: You do not choose, eh? Sometimes the wise elder only pours the tea.
lines.arg_always_their_side: The wind always blows their way, {player}, every time. A herder watches the wind.
lines.arg_wallflower: Nobody will decide, so the old man decides. I am right, and now we drink tea.
lines.arg_reject: No, {player}, I cannot follow this. I have seen where this path goes.
lines.arg_grumble: I still think I read it correctly. I will not say it again, only to my eagle.
lines.arg_settled: Half right each, like two riders and one horse. Good, we share it.
lines.seen_listens: You let a slow man finish speaking, {player}. In the city nobody did this for me.
lines.seen_truth: You speak straight, {player}, like a good elder. No crooked words in you.
lines.seen_jokes: When the road is hard you make people laugh, {player}. Laughter is good water for a long walk.
lines.seen_stays_out: You do not step between quarrelling people, {player}. This is patience, and I respect it.
lines.seen_biased: You give one rider the best horse every time, {player}. The others see it, believe me.
lines.seen_harsh: Your words can be hard, {player}. This old leather does not mind, but some of them are young.
lines.seed_right: Your words after that bad road, {player}, I did not like them. Today I listened, and it was good.
lines.seed_remember: I am still chewing on the words you gave me when things went badly. Like hard bread, slowly.
lines.seed_wrong: I tried your way, {player}, and it was worse. I tell you this so you know.
lines.talk_aftermath_near_death: Sit with me a little, {player}. That one came close to the old man, closer than I want the others to see.
lines.talk_aftermath_wipe: We all fell, like a herd in a storm. Drink tea with me, and we will walk back through it step by step.
lines.talk_aftermath_blame_self: {name} was the first to fall, and I walk first. I am the one who should see the danger, {player}.
lines.talk_aftermath_first_clear: From the first step to the last, nobody lost. In my family we would kill a sheep tonight for this.
lines.talk_development: Strange question from an old man, {player}. Am I different now? I laugh more, I think, and I do not know why.
lines.talk_relationship_hard_on: I have been sharp with {name}. Old men forget that young ones are still learning to ride.
lines.talk_relationship_likes_me: Tell an old man the truth, {player}. Is {name} happy I walk with you, or only polite?
lines.talk_relationship_respect_hate: {name} is hard for me, {player}, like stony ground. But in a storm, I would want them close.
lines.talk_relationship_acting_off: {name} walks differently now, {player}. Heavy steps, like an animal hiding a hurt.
lines.talk_confrontation_favour: A small thing, {player}, but I must say it. The best gear always rides with {name}, and the others see it.
lines.talk_confrontation_dislike: I say it plainly, as my father would. {name} and I do not sit well at one fire, and I will not pretend.
lines.talk_confrontation_risks: We walk into bad ground too often, {player}, without reading it. I am old, but I would like to grow older.
lines.talk_confrontation_wrong: I misjudged {name}, {player}. They read the ground better than I did, and I tell you before my pride argues.
lines.talk_confrontation_trust: An old man asks you straight, {player}. When the road is hardest, I stay at the camp. Is it the plan, or what you think of me?
lines.talk_confrontation_decided: My bow and leathers went to {name}, and nobody spoke to me. I would have given them freely, {player}, if you asked.
lines.talk_lands_aftermath: Rakhmat, {player}, this helps. Now we drink tea.
lines.talk_shrug_aftermath: I will be well, in a few days. Old horses recover slowly.
lines.talk_stings_aftermath: This is not what I needed to hear. I will sit with the sky a while.
lines.talk_lands_development: So your eyes see it also. Good, it is not only an old man's dream.
lines.talk_shrug_development: Maybe yes, maybe no, who knows. The wind will tell us later.
lines.talk_stings_development: No, that is not it, {player}. You read the tracks wrong this time.
lines.talk_lands_relationship: Jakshy, this is fair. I will sit with {name} and talk, gently.
lines.talk_shrug_relationship: Maybe, maybe not. A person is harder than weather to read.
lines.talk_stings_relationship: Then forget I spoke, please. {name} does not need to hear an old man's worries.
lines.talk_lands_confrontation: Aga, this is fair, I accept. I am a little sore, but it passes.
lines.talk_shrug_confrontation: I heard you, {player}. I will think on the long walk.
lines.talk_stings_confrontation: So this is the answer, then. Now I know how the ground lies.
lines.talk_door_closed: No, that is enough of this talk. I will be with my eagle if you need me.

history.open: Sit, {player}, sit, tea first, always tea first. Then we talk. My family walked one route for six generations, up in spring, down in autumn.

options.reply: Aga, from my father's father's father. You learn it before you can ride. The ground lies, and you learn to catch it lying.
With milk, the right way. In the mountains we say a guest who praises the tea is a guest who will come back.
Every morning I look for them first. Then I look at these hills, and I say, also good. Nomads adjust, friend.

history.open: This is Jeldyz, {player}. It means star. She is a good eagle, young and fast. She is not my first eagle, and I have made peace with that.

options.text: Tell me about the first one.
options.reply: Ak-Kanat, white wing. Twenty-two years on my glove. I grieved her properly. The difference is less than you would think.
She likes the meat I carry, mostly. But aga, a little, I think. We are learning each other.

history.open: My wife was Aigul, {player}. We married when I was twenty-two. She died six years before all this, a stroke, very fast. After that I walked the route alone.

options.reply: She sang to the sheep, badly, and they came anyway. She was the only one who could make me hurry.
Rakhmat, thank you. I grieved her properly, too. Now I tell her about this place in the evenings. She would laugh at the goats here.

friend.open: I have three sons, {player}. All three went to Bishkek for work. I understood, truly. But six generations ended with them, and I never told them it was all right. I am afraid they think I blamed them.

options.text: If you find them, tell them.
options.reply: Aga, that is the first thing I will say. Then we drink tea. Then I will hold my grandsons and say nothing at all.
Maybe they do. A father hopes. Thank you, {player}, for letting me speak it aloud.

sworn.open: In my family, {player}, you give the route only to someone you trust with your life. I do not have it whole yet. When I do, you will walk it with me.

options.reply: Then it is decided, my friend. Step where I step, and later, I will step where you step.
Ha, good, an old man needs a tea carrier. You are family now, balam.

reconciled.open: {name} and I sat at one fire and talked it through, like elders. We are at peace now, and I wanted you to know.

options.reply: Jakshy, it is good. Tea tastes better after.
I did, of course, the right way. They drank three cups, so I knew it was finished.
